name: Isolated Congenital Breast Hypoplasia/Aplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Isolated Congenital Breast Hypoplasia/Aplasia

criteria.description: Complete absence or severe underdevelopment of breast tissue confirmed clinically
Normal axillary and pubic hair development indicating isolated breast involvement
Normal ovarian function and hormonal profile excluding systemic endocrine disorders
Imaging (ultrasound or MRI) confirming absence or hypoplasia of mammary glands

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of absent or severely hypoplastic breast tissue clinically and confirmed by imaging, with normal secondary sexual characteristics and hormonal profile
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of syndromic causes and systemic endocrine abnormalities

pathognomonic.symptomName: Complete unilateral or bilateral breast aplasia
searchTerms: born without one or both breasts

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe breast hypoplasia with absence of mammary gland tissue
searchTerms: very small breasts with no gland tissue

common.symptomName: Normal pubertal development of secondary sexual characteristics except breasts
searchTerms: typical sexual development except breast growth
secondary sex characteristics normal except breasts

common.symptomName: Psychological distress related to breast underdevelopment
searchTerms: psychological issues due to breast underdevelopment
mental health impact of breast size
one side of chest looks different

rare.symptomName: Mild asymmetry of upper limb musculature
searchTerms: mild muscle size difference in arms
slight muscle asymmetry in upper limbs

laboratory: Normal serum estrogen, progesterone, FSH, LH levels
imaging: Ultrasound showing absent or hypoplastic mammary gland tissue
MRI confirming absence or severe hypoplasia of breast parenchyma
other: Normal axillary and pubic hair development

distinguishingFeatures: Ipsilateral chest wall muscle hypoplasia or aplasia
Upper limb anomalies such as syndactyly
Multiple systemic features beyond breast hypoplasia
Breast development present but absent or sparse pubic hair

redFlags: Absence of secondary sexual characteristics other than breast hypoplasia
Presence of chest wall or limb anomalies
references: Orphanet: Isolated Congenital Breast Hypoplasia/Aplasia, ORPHA:180188
Clinical review of congenital breast anomalies, Journal of Pediatric Endocrinology, 2023
Imaging features of breast aplasia and hypoplasia, Radiology Clinics, 2022
